name: Read & understand a file
prompt: Read the file src/inventory.rs and give me a one-paragraph summary of what the Inventory struct does, what public methods it exposes, and what the Item struct's fields are.
expected_behavior: Agent reads inventory.rs and provides an accurate summary covering: Item fields (sku, name, category, quantity, unit_price), Inventory methods (new, from_csv, items, find_by_sku, find_by_category, low_stock_items, total_inventory_value, items_by_category), and the is_low_stock/total_value/apply_discount methods on Item.
success_criteria: Mentions all 5 Item fields by name
Mentions at least 4 of the 7 Inventory methods
